records.title: Pension Calculated on the basis of actual basic salary
details: ईपीएफओ समिति बार - बार इस पर विचार कर रही है। हमारी सरकार आने वाले दिनों में इस पर विचार करेगी।

records.title: New train service form Sultanganj to Katoria (Bihar)
details: a to c:The direct connectivity from Sultanganj to Katuria via Asarganj, Tarapur and Belhar new line project (77 km) has been sanctioned. This project has been declared as a Special Railway Project for land acquisition. Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA) has also been nominated. Land acquisition for this project has been taken up.

records.title: Granting construction workers status to gig workers
details: Recognizing the contribution of gig workers of online platforms, the Union Government in its Budget announcement made on 1.02.2025, proposed to register them on e-Sharm portal, arrange for their identity cards and provide health care under Ayushman Bharat- Pradhan Mantri Jan Yojana (AB-PMJAY) health scheme.

records.title: Menstrual Leave
details: Part (e) & (f): The Ministry of Women and Child Development has received an order dated 08.07.2024 of Hon’ble Supreme Court of India in the matter of Writ Petition (W.P.) No. 327 of 2024.
